\section{Workflow}
The process has three stages. Each stage emits a status message.

\begin{itemize}
\item Read the input file.
\item Normalize the values.
\end{itemize}

The normalized score is $s = p/r$.

\begin{equation}
R = \frac{accepted}{received}
\end{equation}
